title: Machine-learning screening finds a myeloperoxidase inhibitor active in cardiomyocytes
summary: Machine-learning virtual screening with consensus docking screened about 3.1 million compounds and gave 25 candidates; compound 16 inhibited myeloperoxidase with IC50 0.297 +/- 0.097 uM and preserved H9c2 cell viability to 66.19% at 25 uM under oxygen-glucose deprivation. It had poor metabolic stability in rat liver microsomes (T1/2 1.34 min). Results are in vitro only.
ai_technology: Machine-learning-based virtual screening combined with structure-based consensus docking

evidence.tested: Enzyme inhibition assay and cell protection assays of 25 candidates.
evidence.unknown: The ML model type and in vivo activity are not stated; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Prioritized candidates from about 3.1 million compounds for testing.

source_review.scope: Abstract read from Europe PMC metadata and author affiliations from Crossref for this DOI. Publisher full text not accessed.
